On a final note, the barrier film is a cheap solution and consists of readily available materials, as shown in Figure 9.1(a), with a cost of $0.002 per gram based on bulk purchasing from commercial suppliers. For example, for a 15% power conversion efficient solar panel, this would equate to a materials cost of $0.002 W-1 for a 50 μm thick barrier film, much lower than the $0.33 W-1 hazardous waste disposal cost for glass perovskite modules. Moreover, the barrier film is also intrinsically flexible and therefore compatible with flexible solar cell applications.
